description: The census: how many local seats, network players and simulated bodies the world holds, and how they are placed and varied.

items.description: Whether a local seat activates automatically at boot (Eager) or waits for a claim (OnDemand) — the per-seat authored policy SeatActivation declares. Both doors converge on the identical Server.WorldPopulation.ActivateSeat call through the same SessionRequest.Join/WorldServer.ApplySession session-join seam regardless of which policy admitted the seat — a seat activated on demand (player.join, or a controller's own hot-plug first touch via Client.PlayerRoster.ResolveDeviceSlot) is indistinguishable from one activated at boot the instant it is active.
items.title: SeatActivationPolicy

x-enumDescriptions.Eager: The seat's body is minted at boot, mirroring a session join for it immediately — the only policy seat 0 (player 1) may declare, since a session always needs a first player.
x-enumDescriptions.OnDemand: The seat stays empty at boot; its body is minted the first time something claims it.

mode.description: Which bodies an observer is delivered.
mode.title: WorldObserverDisclosureMode

x-enumDescriptions.All: Every active body. The default, and what every world authoring no policy delivers.
x-enumDescriptions.Radius: Only bodies within Radius metres of the observer's own body, plus that body itself. An observer with no body of its own is delivered nothing.
x-enumDescriptions.SelfOnly: Only the observer's own body. An observer with no body of its own is delivered nothing.

radius.description: The disclosure radius in metres for Radius; authored only for that mode.

updateSeconds.description: The minimum interval between remote projection snapshots. Zero requests every authority tick; the default is 0.03 seconds (30 Hz on the standard 240 Hz authority after whole-step quantization). Local in-process sinks are unaffected.

title: WorldBodiesDefaults
